scores.visual_critic_note: Cohesive dark theme with a thoughtful CSS custom-property palette and well-proportioned multi-panel layout (network + color scatter + timeline + thumbnail gallery), but the force graph is too dense and small to extract meaning at the rendered size, and 9px node labels push below readable threshold.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Strong encoding integrity: scaleSqrt used correctly for node/dot radii, bar baseline starts at zero with domain([0, maxCount]), all scale domains are data-driven (d3.extent/d3.max), no dual axes, no line gaps issue; minor: fgBars.data(binner(filtered)) rebind lacks a key function but positional stability of monthly bins prevents visible corruption.
scores.stress_test_note: Dirty-flag + RAF coalescing is correctly implemented, preventing update storms; no transitions mean no mid-flight conflicts; pointer events avoid mouse-touch fights; but no ResizeObserver or resize handler means x/y scales and canvas dimensions go stale if the window is resized after init.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four linked crossfilter views are conceptually manageable and the force layout is pre-settled (400 ticks, no reheat on filter), but the 60-node network reads as a moderate hairball and the thumbnail wall is dense enough that the bottom panel shifts from comparison to lookup.
